description: The file defines a Spring service class 'MoneyHelperStartupInitializationService' responsible for initializing the MoneyHelper component for all tenants during application startup. It implements 'InitializingBean' to perform actions after properties are set, primarily initializing MoneyHelper for each tenant found via 'TenantDetailsService'. It relies on multiple other services and is annotated with Spring stereotypes and Lombok annotations for dependency injection and logging.

classes.name: MoneyHelperStartupInitializationService
classes.description: A Spring service that initializes the MoneyHelper for all tenants during application startup, after properties are set.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Performs initialization logic for all tenants after bean properties are set, including logging and conditional initialization checks.
